# Wilky Productions

> Southern California based design company specializing in videography, photography, graphic design, logo design, and website design. Based in Menifee, CA, serving Southern California.

Wilky Productions is a one-person creative studio run by Johnny Wilkinson, covering video, photo, and design work for weddings, businesses, real estate, motorsports/offroad, and events.

## Services

- [Videography](https://www.wilkyproductions.com/videos): Weddings, business spotlights, real estate walkthroughs, offroad/car videos, and aerial videography. Packages starting at $500.
- [Photography](https://www.wilkyproductions.com/photography): Family photos, events, and racing/motorsports coverage.
- [Website Design](https://www.wilkyproductions.com/website-design): New site builds or redesigns, from brochure sites to custom storefronts.
- [Graphic & Logo Design](https://www.wilkyproductions.com/design): Logos, apparel graphics, motorsports imagery, and brand identity work.
